name: User
description: Core user entity containing authentication credentials, profile information, and account metadata for personalized AI assistant interactions

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user account

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication

fields.name: passwordHash
fields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: User's first name for personalization

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: User's last name for personalization

fields.name: profileImageUrl
fields.description: URL to user's profile image

fields.name: accountStatus
fields.description: Current status of the account (active, suspended, pending)

fields.name: lastLoginAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the user's last login

email.message: Must be a valid email address

accountStatus.message: Must be a valid account status

name: ErrorLog
description: Tracks system errors, AI processing failures, and exceptions for monitoring, debugging, and self-healing capabilities

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the error log entry

fields.name: errorType
fields.description: Category of error (e.g., AI_PROCESSING, NETWORK, DATABASE, VALIDATION)

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong

fields.name: stackTrace
fields.description: Technical stack trace for debugging purposes

fields.name: userId
fields.description: ID of the user associated with the error, if applicable

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Error severity level (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

fields.name: resolved
fields.description: Whether the error has been resolved or acknowledged

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the error occurred

relationships.description: Links error to the user who experienced it

indexes.name: idx_error_type_severity
indexes.description: Optimize queries filtering by error type and severity

indexes.name: idx_user_created
indexes.description: Optimize queries for user-specific error history

constraints.errorType: Must be one of: AI_PROCESSING, NETWORK, DATABASE, VALIDATION, AUTHENTICATION, AUTHORIZATION, SYSTEM
constraints.severity: Must be one of: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL

name: UserPreferences
description: Store user-specific preferences for personalized AI responses and app settings

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for user preferences record

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the User who owns these preferences

fields.name: language
fields.description: Preferred language code for AI responses (e.g., en, es, fr)

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: User's timezone for time-aware responses (e.g., America/New_York)

fields.name: responseStyle
fields.description: Preferred AI response style (e.g., concise, detailed, casual, formal)

fields.name: interests
fields.description: List of user interests and topics for personalized content

fields.name: notificationPreferences
fields.description: Notification settings including enabled channels and frequency

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp of last preference update

relationships.description: Each preference set belongs to one user

constraints.uniqueUserPreferences: Each user can have only one preferences record
constraints.validLanguage: Language must be a valid ISO 639-1 code
constraints.validTimezone: Timezone must be a valid IANA timezone identifier

name: ChatSession
description: Represents a distinct chat conversation session with metadata for organizing conversations by topic or time period

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the chat session

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who owns this chat session

fields.name: title
fields.description: User-defined or auto-generated title for the chat session

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the session (active, archived, deleted)

fields.name: messageCount
fields.description: Total number of messages in this session

fields.name: lastActivityAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the last message or activity in this session

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the chat session was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the chat session was last updated

relationships.description: Each chat session belongs to a user

indexes.description: Optimize queries for user's recent chat sessions

name: ConversationContext
description: Stores contextual information and conversation state to enable coherent, context-aware AI responses across messages

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the conversation context

fields.name: sessionId
fields.description: Reference to the associated chat session

fields.name: contextSummary
fields.description: Condensed summary of the conversation for quick context retrieval

fields.name: entities
fields.description: Extracted entities (people, places, dates, etc.) mentioned in the conversation

fields.name: topics
fields.description: List of main topics discussed in the conversation

fields.name: sentiment
fields.description: Overall sentiment of the conversation (positive, neutral, negative)

fields.name: messageReferences
fields.description: Array of message IDs that contributed to this context

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.description: Timestamp of the last context update

relationships.description: Each context belongs to one chat session

name: AIResponse
description: Stores AI-generated responses with metadata for quality tracking and performance monitoring

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the AI response

fields.name: messageId
fields.description: Reference to the user message that triggered this response

fields.name: responseContent
fields.description: The actual AI-generated response content

fields.name: model
fields.description: AI model used to generate the response (e.g., gpt-4, claude-3)

fields.name: confidenceScore
fields.description: Confidence score of the response quality (0.0 to 1.0)

fields.name: processingTime
fields.description: Time taken to generate response in milliseconds

fields.name: tokensUsed
fields.description: Total tokens consumed for this response generation

fields.name: generatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the response was generated

relationships.description: Multiple AI responses belong to one chat session

name: UserSession
description: Manages user authentication sessions, tokens, and device information for security and session management

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique session identifier

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the authenticated user

fields.name: sessionToken
fields.description: JWT or unique token for session authentication

fields.name: refreshToken
fields.description: Token used to refresh expired session tokens

fields.name: deviceInfo
fields.description: Device details (OS, model, app version) in JSON format

fields.name: ipAddress
fields.description: IP address from which session was created

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description: Timestamp when session expires

fields.name: lastActivityAt
fields.description: Timestamp of last user activity in this session

relationships.description: Each session belongs to one user

constraints.sessionTokenUnique: sessionToken must be unique across all active sessions
constraints.expirationValidation: expiresAt must be greater than current timestamp
constraints.tokenSecurity: sessionToken and refreshToken must be hashed/encrypted at rest

name: Message
description: Stores individual chat messages exchanged between user and AI assistant with metadata and processing status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the message

fields.name: sessionId
fields.description: Reference to the chat session this message belongs to

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who owns this message

fields.name: content
fields.description: The actual message text content

fields.name: senderRole
fields.description: Role of the sender (user or assistant)

fields.name: processingStatus
fields.description: Current processing status (pending, processing, completed, failed)

fields.name: tokens
fields.description: Number of tokens used for this message

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the message was created

relationships.description: Message belongs to a chat session

indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of messages by session in chronological order
Optimize queries for messages by processing status

senderRole.description: Sender role must be either user or assistant

processingStatus.description: Processing status must be one of the defined states
